div.div: Legend: green = isolated (YES) yellow = partial red = not isolated (NO). Two independent conflicts: SM lockout (fix with occupancy/partition control) and controller contention (fix with footprint control). Streams give concurrency, never protection. The ~172 GB/s CPU-memory floor no scheduler moves.

text.tspan: Legend: green = isolated (YES) yellow = partial red = not isolated (NO). Two independent conflicts: SM lockout (fix with occupancy/partition control) and controller contention (fix with footprint control).
Streams give concurrency, never protection. The ~172 GB/s CPU-memory floor no scheduler moves.
